14:20.race_name: Lycetts Insurance Mares' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners.breeder: R N And Mrs M A Jukes
runners.comment: 16-1 and beaten 32l in point bumper (good) when hooded and tongue tied in December
runners.name: Bits Ballou
runners.spotlight: 16-1 and beaten 32l in a point bumper at Larkhill (good) when hooded and tongue tied in December; has joined a good yard but needs plenty more on this introduction to hurdles.

runners.comment: Modest third in seller in sole completed attempt over hurdles; drops in trip
runners.name: Borna Gem
runners.spotlight: Irish point winner on heavy; beaten favourite in both bumpers and modest third in seller in sole completed attempt over hurdles; 100-1 and pulled up at Southwell (also about 2m4f, soft) last time; drop in trip might help but it needs to.

runners.comment: Bumper winner; form of hurdle debut was boosted at Cheltenham last week; excuse latest
runners.name: Caterpillar Girl
runners.spotlight: All three starts over 2m on good ground; 15-2 and won small-field bumper at Warwick in May; beaten 23l on hurdles debut at Worcester in October but that form received an elephantine boost when the winner landed the Dawn Run at last week's Cheltenham Festival; had an excuse (bled) when last seen in November; requires a second look.

runners.comment: Increasingly bigger prices and beat a total of three rivals across three bumpers this term
runners.name: Dame In Disguise
runners.spotlight: Increasingly bigger prices and she beat a total of three rivals across three bumpers this term; switch to hurdles needs to prompt serious improvement.

runners.comment: Back from an absence and showed nothing at 66-1 on hurdles/stable debut 45 days ago
runners.name: Georgias Charm
runners.spotlight: Promise in first two bumpers, in Ireland and for Harry Fry, but she signed off for the latter with a disappointing run at Uttoxeter in October 2024; came back from an absence and showed nothing at 66-1 on hurdles/stable debut 45 days ago.

runners.comment: Well beaten on hurdles debut over C&D (good to soft) three weeks ago
runners.name: Lady Blackmore
runners.spotlight: Second in two Irish points in the autumn but it was a heavy defeat in Huntingdon bumper on rules debut in January and again well beaten on hurdles debut over C&D (good to soft) three weeks ago.

runners.comment: 2m3f 3rd was a solid effort in January; not stay 3m latest; tongue-tie on; obvious claims
runners.name: October Hill
runners.spotlight: Yet to score in eight attempts over hurdles but she's been placed five times, in Ireland and for David Pipe, and her third of 13 at Taunton (2m3f, good to soft) was a solid effort in January; hasn't quite matched that in two subsequent starts but didn't stay 3m last time and now drops back down in trip in a modest event; tongue-tie added and she holds obvious claims.

runners.comment: Can't recommend on hurdle form but this is easier; not beyond the realms she'll show more
runners.name: Babychino
runners.spotlight: Runner-up in seller for Adrian Keatley in sole Flat start; tough tasks when pulled up in first two starts over hurdles and she raced wide and freely when beaten 39l in today's hood at Warwick 11 days ago; this is easier and it's not beyond the realms she can take a step forward.

runners.comment: 300-1 and struggling from early stage when pulled up last month; cheekpieces go on
runners.name: Cantcallmethattrev
runners.spotlight: £1,000 yearling by Bobby's Kitten; 300-1 and she was struggling from an early stage when pulled up at Hereford last month; cheekpieces go on.

runners.comment: 50-1 and beaten 49l in October bumper; dam was a five-time winning hurdler, though
runners.name: Dinkys Rose
runners.spotlight: 50-1 and beaten 49l in Stratford bumper in October; dam was a five-time winning hurdler so possible she'll do better in this sphere.

runners.comment: Disappointing yard debut latest; previous 5th was encouraging; considered in this company
runners.name: Queen Maeve
runners.spotlight: Fairly promising fifth of 15 on hurdles debut at Leopardstown (2m2f, good to yielding) in December; that form has taken one or two knocks, however, and it was a disappointing stable debut when 15-8 but beaten 26l at Hereford last month; still early days and she needs firm consideration in this company.

runners.comment: Solid start in course bumper (good); tough task on C&D hurdle debut latest; player in this
runners.name: Silvereen
runners.spotlight: Solid start when fourth of eight in course bumper (good) in November; hasn't built on that on soft ground since, including when 125-1 and last of seven finishers on her hurdle debut over C&D six weeks ago; that was a tidy little affair, however, and she can be expected to do much better in this lesser contest.

runners.breeder: C A F R E Enniskellen Campus
runners.comment: Still looks a work in progress; latest effort offered hope he might be putting it together
runners.name: Bond Broker
runners.spotlight: Bumper winner who picked up maiden and novice hurdles (about 2m1f; good to soft and good) last term; beaten a combined 62l despite finishing second in three of his four subsequent chases but still looks a work in progress and his latest effort offered hope he might be putting it together; weakened on his one try at this sort of trip under rules.

runners.comment: Not stay latest but previous 6th solid; had wind surgery; might be worth another chance
runners.name: Batwomen
runners.spotlight: Both wins over hurdles came at Fontwell; having just her second go over fences when solid sixth in well-contested mares' handicap at Cheltenham (about 2m4f, good to soft) in December; disappointed at Huntingdon over further next time but had wind surgery shortly afterwards and might be worth another chance dropped back in trip.

runners.breeder: G F A Du Pont Rouge
runners.comment: Won in October and competitive off this mark since; can go well fresh & looks a key player
runners.name: Gris Majeur
runners.owner: Exors Of The Late Brian Davies
runners.spotlight: Made the breakthrough over fences in four-runner contest over C&D (good to firm) on reappearance in October and ran well over further on both outings the following month; comes back from a 112-day break with any quickening of the ground firmly in his favour; player.

runners.comment: Fair start over fences; pulled up after sprawling latest; competitive with clear round
runners.name: The Winslow Boy
runners.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo who landed a Chepstow novice hurdle (good to soft) in November 2024 and it was a respectable start over fences when third back there (also 2m, good; mistake last) just over one year later; pulled up after he sprawled on landing around halfway at Hereford next time; still has stamina to prove but a clear round should see him competitive.

runners.comment: Hurdle winner on this card last year; bad blunder on chase debut; still early days
runners.name: Sun Art
runners.spotlight: Tongue tied when making virtually all in five-runner novice hurdle on this card 12 months ago; didn't repeat that form in two novices (also about 2m, good) in November and a bad mistake contributed to heavy defeat on his chase debut at Leicester in December; goes up in trip for this second attempt and it's still early days.

runners.comment: Close 2nd when last seen; makes chase debut after 489 days away; market can offer clues
runners.name: Kay Tara Tara
runners.spotlight: Bumper (AW) and maiden hurdle winner for Alan King but she didn't progress; wore a tongue-tie when fair fifth on debut for this yard in November 2024 and she built on that in added cheekpieces when close second of four at Newcastle (also about 2m4f, good) a fortnight later; makes chase debut after 489 days away with the market likely to offer some clues.

runners.comment: Handicap newcomer whose Flat form makes this opening hurdle mark look dangerous
runners.name: Fouroneohfever
runners.spotlight: Four wins for George Boughey at 1m2f/1m4f and useful in that scene; wouldn't have won but displayed some ability until falling at Sandown on hurdles debut in January; also offered something to work on in two starts the following month; Flat form makes this opening hurdle mark look dangerous.

runners.breeder: His Highness The Aga Khans Studs S C
runners.comment: Maiden hurdle winner; refused both Flat starts when last seen in October; stable debut
runners.name: Razdan
runners.owner: Moorland Racing & Menzies A M Ltd
runners.spotlight: Very capable on the Flat and he won his last start in this sphere when landing a Downpatrick maiden hurdle (2m3f, good) in April 2024; patchy form in nine starts on the Flat since and he refused to race on both outings when last seen in October; stable debut.

runners.comment: Three-time hurdle winner who took a step back in right direction 11 days ago; respected
runners.name: Gifted Angel
runners.spotlight: 3-8 over hurdles for Tom Dascombe (often with forcing tactics) and he won his first two on the Flat once joining this yard; solid fourth of 13 from the rear at Warwick (2m, good to soft; kept on) 11 days ago; respected.

runners.comment: Looked unlucky penultimate start & he's a player on this handicap debut back down in trip
runners.name: Three Pikes
runners.spotlight: Won a Newton Abbot bumper on his debut for this yard in June and consistent in three qualifying runs over hurdles, including when looking unlucky at that track (about 2m2f, good) in August on penultimate start; not seen since third over 2m4f in September but he's a player on this handicap debut back down in trip.

runners.comment: Hood discarded but he brings potential to this handicap debut and warrants respect
runners.name: Knighton
runners.spotlight: Fairly close second of four in 1m4f Ripon novice (good) in sole start on the Flat last September; getting the hang of things in three qualifying starts over hurdles, on the last two occasions on soft ground in a hood; that aid is discarded but he brings potential to this handicap debut and warrants respect.

15:50.race_name: Bromfield Sand And Gravel Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: Well handicapped and encouraging third latest; big danger if he builds on that
runners.name: Uncle Phil
runners.spotlight: Very well handicapped on old form for Willie Mullins; nothing to shout about in first four runs for this yard but there was some encouragement last time, despite beating just one home, when third at Hereford (2m, good) 12 days ago; big danger if he builds on that from a career-low mark.

runners.comment: 2nd at the start of the month; back in trip and also needs considering off career-low mark
runners.name: Tax For Max
runners.spotlight: Another previously useful ex-Mullins horse who's yet to score for this yard; some fair efforts, though, including when second of six at Huntingdon (2m4f, good to soft) at the start of the month; drops back in trip and also needs considering from a career-low mark.

runners.comment: 1-1 here, that win coming over C&D on penultimate start; firmly in calculations
runners.name: Rumoursareflying
runners.spotlight: 1-1 here, that win coming over C&D (good; 18-1) in November on his penultimate start; not beaten far when fourth of six at Doncaster (also about 2m, good to soft) the following month and he's another who is firmly in calculations.

runners.comment: Wind surgery sent him on a roll, a win over C&D triggering a hat-trick; solid third latest
runners.name: Supreme George
runners.spotlight: Beaten 32l on his chase debut in October but subsequent wind surgery sent him on a roll, a win over C&D (good to soft) in December triggering a hat-trick; nothing wrong with his third of six at Sedgefield last time and he may still be capable of better.

runners.comment: Yet to get going for this yard but this is a significant drop in grade; far from ruled out
runners.name: Krak
runners.spotlight: Won Cork handicap (2m3f, soft) on final start for Stuart Crawford 11 months ago; weakened quickly on stable debut in Chepstow Grade 2 (about 2m3f) in October before being well held in two chases in December; weakened again over 2m5f in Kempton's Lanzarote (good) last time but should do better given this significant drop in grade.

runners.comment: Off since December but unexposed and respected if giving himself a chance to stay new trip
runners.name: Dont Mind If I Do
runners.spotlight: Good second in valuable Newbury bumper two years ago; raced freely before a solid third on his handicap debut at Aintree (2m1f, good to soft) in November and that trait was again in evidence when fifth of ten at Huntingdon (2m, soft) the following month; off since and he could do with settling down stepping up in trip but he's unexposed in this sphere.

runners.comment: Stays much further and should be suited by this drying ground; expect him to go forward
runners.name: Sunshine Diamond
runners.spotlight: Frequent front-runner; doubled his tally when narrowly making a successful stable debut in Southwell novice (about 3m, good) in October 2024; bettered that form when second at Warwick (3m2f, good to soft) in December but his hurdling lacked fluency when unable to justify favouritism at Market Rasen (2m7f, soft) last month; this forecast better ground should suit but the drop in trip asks a question; will probably look to make this a test of stamina.

runners.comment: Well-handicapped veteran whose latest seventh at Windsor is working out; player
runners.name: Stoners Choice
runners.spotlight: Second of 12 over 2m5f at Kempton just over a year ago but he hasn't posed a serious threat since, including at about 2m on his last four starts; wasn't disgraced in a valuable event at Windsor (strong handicap form) last time, however, and he's undoubtedly well handicapped these days.

runners.breeder: K Perreau L Colson & E Lejault
runners.comment: Not fully exposed and has run well both starts here; new trip a small query but respected
runners.name: Walkadina
runners.owner: Prof C Tisdall J White & A Underhill
runners.spotlight: 1-8 over hurdles; ran well behind revitalised opponent here (2m, good to soft) in December but wasn't in the same form at Ascot (1m7f, soft) when last seen a fortnight later; faded on her only previous start over 2m5f but that did come after a 237-day break; not fully exposed.

runners.comment: Likes a sound surface; shaped okay when last seen; can race freely but considered
runners.name: Byzantium
runners.spotlight: Came good with comfortable handicap win at Warwick (2m3f) in June and easily followed up in modest novice event at Newton Abbot (2m5f) three weeks later; didn't shape too badly when fourth at Ascot (about 2m3f, also good) on his November comeback but absent since; can race freely but this drying ground should suit and he's respected.

runners.breeder: E A R L Haras Du Camp Benard
runners.comment: 2-2 here; excuses latest and should make his presence felt back up in trip; tongue-tie off
runners.name: Royal Way
runners.spotlight: Useful juvenile in 2023-24 season, his three wins including two here (2m); hasn't lived up to those early expectations but his third of 15 at Huntingdon (about 2m4f, also soft) was a solid effort in January; undone by heavy ground and a drop in trip at Fontwell (first-time cheekpieces) last time but might do better given these conditions; tongue-tie removed.

runners.comment: Big improvement when scoring at 20-1 (C&D, soft) latest; up 8lb but she's unexposed
runners.name: Windsor Blue
runners.spotlight: Beaten 30l on her handicap debut (good to soft) in December but found a big chunk of improvement when down in grade and scoring at 20-1 (also C&D, soft) in February; this race is warmer and she has an 8lb rise to contend with but is unexposed.

runners.comment: Tailed off on her return from a 617-day absence at Wetherby (about 2m5f, soft) in December
runners.name: Golden Glance
runners.spotlight: Haydock maiden hurdle (2m3f, good to soft) winner in April 2023 who had bits and pieces of handicap form the following season; tailed off on her return from a 617-day absence at Wetherby (about 2m5f, soft) in December and that outing will have needed to bring her on a good deal.

16:50.race_name: EFG Harris Allday Open Hunters' Chase (For The Ludlow Gold Cup)

runners.comment: Poor in eight starts since September; latest pulled up was third non completion in a row
runners.name: Frere dArmes
runners.spotlight: Odds-on third in this race last year before comfortably making all in Stratford hunter chase (2m1f, good) in May; hasn't got near the latter form in eight starts since September however and latest pulled up, despite attracting some support, was a third non completion in a row; others look safer.

runners.comment: Fine second at Aintree (2m5f, good to soft) in November; big claims despite latest spill
runners.name: Gaboriot
runners.spotlight: Pulled up in the Becher Chase at Aintree in December but finished a very good second in the Grand Sefton (2m5f, good to soft) the previous month; returned to hunter chasing with quite a spill at Catterick a fortnight ago but holds leading claims if that hasn't left a mark.

runners.comment: Not disgraced in January hunter chase; beaten 20l in latest point but he's not ruled out
runners.name: Guy
runners.spotlight: Used to like it here, not out of the first three in five starts including over fences and when winning a novice hurdle in 2023; first start for this yard when far from disgraced in Taunton hunter chase (about 2m5f, good) in January but his 20l defeat at Cocklebarrow (3m) later that month was disappointing; still not ruled out.

runners.comment: Hasn't got going in three starts for this yard (3m) but the drop back in trip might help
runners.name: Hold Onto The Line
runners.spotlight: Three-time winner over fences for James Ewart (2m-2m4f) but he didn't get going for Olly Murphy and it's been a similar story in two points and a hunter chase (all about 3m) for these connections; the drop back in trip might help, though.

runners.comment: In fine form in points last spring but his comeback wasn't laden with promise 11 days ago
runners.name: Galileo Silver
runners.spotlight: Flat, hurdles and chase winner who picked up three points (all 3m on a sound surface) by a combined 38l last spring; fair fourth in Cartmel hunter chase in May but his comeback at Bangor's point course wasn't laden with promise 11 days ago; first start at this trip since finishing second over hurdles in 2022.

runners.comment: Conditions should suit and latest second was a step back in the right direction; player
runners.name: Killer Clown
runners.spotlight: Formerly very useful chaser for Emma Lavelle who is 1-1 for Daisy White, having won at Knightwick (2m4f, good to soft) in November 2024; landed three more points last spring and his latest second at Cocklebarrow (3m) was a step back in the right direction after two big defeats; looks a player with this trip and drying ground in his favour.

runners.comment: Struggled last year and similar story this; first-time cheekpieces need to turn him around
runners.name: Rewritetherules
runners.spotlight: Struck for the first time since 2021 with two wide-margin point wins towards the end of 2024 but it's been a struggle since and first-time cheekpieces need to have a fairly dramatic effect.

runners.comment: Won maiden hurdle in 2023; back from three-year absence when pulled up in point last month
runners.name: Amidnightstar
runners.spotlight: 33-1 when runner-up on her bumper debut for James Evans in 2022 and was 28-1 when winning a Hereford maiden hurdle by 10l in February 2023; back from a three-year absence when 8-1 but weakening quickly at Brocklesby Park (3m, good to soft; pulled up) four weeks ago; can probably do better with that outing behind her but she's impossible to assess accurately.

runners.comment: Wind surgery before encouraging Stratford second (2m5f, soft) last week; can go well again
runners.name: Missed Tee
runners.spotlight: Third in this race in 2024 and she easily won a ladies open at Chaddesley Corbett (3m, good) in May; had wind surgery (her third) before an encouraging second in novice hunter chase at Stratford (2m5f, soft) despite having the door slammed in her face on the home turn ten days ago; should go well again.

14:40.race_name: Winning Connections Conference Hire Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

runners.comment: 12yo who has won three times this season, the latest comfortably at Plumpton last month
runners.name: Enjoy dAllen
runners.spotlight: Versatile 12yo who has won three times this season (2m5f-3m5f, good/soft), the latest comfortably under Lily Jones in a small field at Plumpton last month; inconsistent of late but a key player if again on a going day.

runners.comment: He can have a big say if transferring his recent strong hurdle form here back to fences
runners.name: Ballin Bay
runners.spotlight: Failed to threaten in 2024 on his two previous chase starts but he's in much better form now having won over hurdles here on his last two starts (3m3f, good to soft/soft); has shown promise on good ground; he's just 5lb higher than when easily making all four weeks ago in first-time cheekpieces (retained) and can have a big say if transferring that form back to fences.

runners.comment: Made it 3-6 over fences when winning at Catterick; could have more to offer in this sphere
runners.name: Asa
runners.spotlight: Close third over hurdles at Wetherby (3m, soft) in January then made it 3-6 over fences when winning at Catterick (3m1f, soft); has won on good ground; it was a weak race last time but she's unexposed over fences and could still have more to offer in this sphere; respected.

15:10.race_name: Paxtons No1 CaseIH Dealer In UK&Ireland Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: Close second last month and could have a big part to play now back on better ground
runners.name: De Deli Counter
runners.spotlight: Unseated on handicap hurdle debut in January, then close second from the front at Market Rasen (2m4f, good to soft) next time; soft ground/2m7f may not have suited at Fakenham since; this unexposed 5yo could have a big part to play now back on better ground.

runners.comment: Second in two bumpers but has struggled in her first two handicaps; a tongue-tie goes on
runners.name: My My My Delilah
runners.spotlight: Second in two bumpers but well beaten on handicap debut here (2m1f, good to soft) in January and tailed off when unseating two out at Newcastle (2m1f, good to soft) since; tongue-tie goes on; transformation needed.

runners.comment: Maiden but continues to drop down the weights and stable is in fine form on the Flat
runners.name: Expelliarmus
runners.spotlight: Ex-Irish maiden who is yet to race beyond an extended 2m1f; however, she ran okay when 14l third here (good to soft) in January and continues to drop down the weights; stable in fine form on the Flat; not ruled out.

runners.comment: One to watch in the betting on her stable debut but she achieved very little in Ireland
runners.name: Venturevango
runners.spotlight: Very lightly raced 7yo who is one to watch in the betting on her stable debut; however, she achieved very little across her five starts in Ireland and dramatic improvement is necessary.

runners.comment: Escapes a penalty for last week's win here and he could be tough to beat
runners.name: Cosmic Soul
runners.owner: M Lee D Lee C Jolley & Neville
runners.spotlight: Won on the Flat at Southwell (2m, AW) in January and followed up here (2m1f, good) last Tuesday, which was his second run in a handicap hurdle; escapes a penalty for that recent win and there can be considerable optimism that he'll be suited by this step up in trip; could be tough to beat.

runners.comment: 4th on handicap debut at Carlisle and could build on that run now back on a better surface
runners.name: Knockeranna Rose
runners.spotlight: Yet to threaten over hurdles but last month's fourth on handicap debut at Carlisle (2m3f, soft) wasn't without promise and this good-ground bumper runner-up may build on that latest run now he's back on a better surface.

runners.comment: Well beaten on her three hurdle starts but this point winner has a basement opening mark
runners.name: Nevershedatear
runners.spotlight: Well beaten on her three hurdle starts (2m3f/2m1f, soft/good to soft) but she now goes handicapping off a basement mark and it will be no surprise if this 3m point winner (yielding) shows improvement; watch the market.

runners.comment: The forecast good ground could be a positive but a major turnaround is necessary
runners.name: Long Time Listener
runners.spotlight: Point-to-point bumper winner for whom the forecast good ground could be a positive; however, he's struggled in his first three handicaps and a major turnaround is necessary; wears first-time cheekpieces.

runners.comment: He's shown little but has very lowly opening mark and trainer's last two runners have won
runners.name: Kampari
runners.spotlight: He's shown little across his seven starts but makes his handicap debut off a very lowly mark and his trainer's last two runners have won, so he's worth a second look.

runners.comment: 0-11 but some okay form for this yard and she's not ruled out each-way
runners.name: Laddie Cooper Mia
runners.spotlight: 0-11 but she's run okay on two of her three starts for this yard (2m5f/2m4f, good/good to soft; including here) and continues to edge down the weights; not ruled out each-way.

runners.comment: The odd fair run last year but this longstanding maiden needs to improve on those efforts
runners.name: Mr Globalist
runners.spotlight: Ran the occasional reasonable race last year but this longstanding maiden needs to improve on those efforts if he's to get off the mark today.

15:40.race_name: Roxyfet Sports Lounge For Private Hire Novices' Hurdle (Novices' Championship Hurdle Qual') (GBB)

runners.breeder: Dr V Roger-Yves Simon & Nicolas Simon &
runners.comment: Won at Taunton last month on second hurdle start; top stable 5-7 here in last five seasons
runners.name: A King Of Magic
runners.spotlight: Won by a neck in a first-time tongue-tie (retained) at Taunton (2m, heavy) last month on his second hurdle start and the runner-up has since gone one better; showed promise on good to soft in a bumper (unraced on good); strong claims for top trainer who is 5-7 here in the last five seasons.

runners.comment: Won here on rules debut; underwhelming at Newcastle since but not written off
runners.name: Buddah Castle
runners.owner: T Alderson & Ales And Dales Syndicate
runners.spotlight: Good-ground point winner who scored on his rules debut here (2m4f, soft) in December despite hanging badly right, with a subsequent winner in second; underwhelming at Newcastle (2m4f, soft) since but not written off.

runners.comment: Impressive on hurdle debut at Southwell and it was a Grade 2 in which he tailed off latest
runners.name: Desertmore News
runners.spotlight: Third in sole point (3m, yielding) and well backed when easily making all on rules debut in maiden hurdle at Southwell (2m, good to soft) last month; tailed off in Grade 2 at Kempton 19 days later but retains potential and he's a leading candidate if rediscovering the Southwell promise.

runners.comment: Useful on the Flat but soundly beaten on both hurdle starts; may need headgear
runners.name: Chillingham
runners.spotlight: Displayed useful Flat form as recently as the autumn and it's very early days over hurdles, but he's been soundly beaten on both starts in this code; may be of greater interest when back in headgear.

runners.comment: Point winner but tailed off at 200-1 on recent hurdle debut when back from a long absence
runners.name: Millford Hill
runners.spotlight: One win (in 2023) from his five point starts; tailed off at 200-1 on recent hurdle debut at Newcastle when back from a long absence.

runners.comment: Two point wins but soundly beaten on both hurdle starts and he may be one for handicaps
runners.name: Passing Diamond
runners.spotlight: Two point wins in Ireland and he also showed promise in bumpers there; however, soundly beaten over hurdles on both British starts and he may be one for handicaps.

16:10.race_name: Paxtons Serving Farmers Since 1853 Handicap Hurdle

runners.comment: C&D runner-up last month and subsequent below-par run can be excused by the soft ground
runners.name: Scudamore
runners.spotlight: Just 1-17 over hurdles but runner-up over C&D (good to soft) last month after a break and his lesser effort at Warwick 16 days later can be excused by the soft ground; conditions set to suit today; firmly in calculations.

runners.comment: Step back in right direction at Southwell and could build on it now up in trip
runners.name: Farmer Jimmy
runners.owner: J Scarrow I Barker & S Turner
runners.spotlight: Promising second at Wetherby (3m, soft) in November; hasn't kicked on from that but Southwell (2m4f, soft) four weeks ago was a step back in the right direction and he could build on it now that he is up in trip; also effective on good ground; not ruled out.

runners.comment: Has been struggling but on testing ground; today's conditions are much more suitable
runners.name: Wee Alki
runners.spotlight: He's struggled on his last three starts but those were on soft/heavy going and he won off today's mark at Hexham (2m7f, good to soft) in November; could bounce back and play a leading role back on this better ground.

runners.comment: Second at Carlisle last month and next run may have come too soon; might not be far away
runners.name: Its Maisy
runners.spotlight: Runner-up at Carlisle (3m1f, soft) last month and perhaps the race came too soon when fourth to Dillarchie at Catterick (3m1f, good to soft) eight days later; probably okay on good ground; might not be far away.

runners.comment: Won at Catterick last month; she's gone up just 3lb and could be bang there once more
runners.name: Dillarchie
runners.spotlight: Third, 1l behind runner-up Scudamore, over C&D (good to soft) last month then won at Catterick (3m1f, good to soft); has run well on good ground; she's gone up just 3lb for last time and could be bang there once more.

runners.comment: 10yo who hasn't shown enough of late to suggest he's the one to be on today
runners.name: Community Rebel
runners.spotlight: Won maiden hurdle in January 2023; however, this 10yo is 0-15 since and hasn't shown enough of late to suggest he's the one to be on today.

runners.comment: Held when hampered late on C&D return, taking record to 0-9; new headgear now
runners.name: Panthere Noir
runners.spotlight: 0-9 and didn't appear to be making any impression when hampered in the closing stages on his C&D reappearance a fortnight ago; first-time blinkers replace cheekpieces.

runners.comment: Better effort in handicaps when 2l fifth over 7f in blinkers latest; more needed
runners.name: Hamish Leek
runners.spotlight: Better effort switched to handicaps last month when 2l fifth of 11 over 7f at Kempton in first-time blinkers (retained); being eased another 2lb can only help.

runners.comment: Comfortably held in two course handicaps; cheekpieces need to spark improvement
runners.name: Fickle McSelfish
runners.spotlight: Hasn't improved for a switch to handicap company here in recent months; first-time cheekpieces will need to spark improvement.

runners.comment: 6f course win in November; fair fourth here (6f again) last week; second attempt at 7f
runners.name: Container Express
runners.spotlight: Narrowly won 6f selling nursery here off 1lb lower in November; respectable keeping-on fourth in 6f course handicap last week; steps up to 7f for just a second time.

runners.comment: Has faded over 1m in her two handicaps so may benefit from the drop back to 7f
runners.name: Monks Hill
runners.owner: Alfa Site Services Ltd & Graeme Curnow
runners.spotlight: Faded into fourth on her 1m handicap debut at Southwell in January and weakened again kept to 1m at Kempton (also hooded) since; the drop back to 7f may help.

runners.comment: Twice third over C&D this winter but not so good over 6f the last twice
runners.name: Runninman
runners.spotlight: Finished third on his first three AW starts (including twice over C&D) but not so good over 6f since; a step back up in trip needs to spark a revival.

runners.comment: Placed in two turf handicaps last year; cheekpieces added on return; claims if ready to go
runners.name: Spartacus Warrior
runners.spotlight: Placed in two turf handicaps last year, including at Leicester when last seen in October; first-time cheekpieces are added on reappearance; likely to be competitive if ready to roll.

runners.comment: Only just failed to get up over 7f at Chelmsford last week; obvious chance off same mark
runners.name: Trucial Pearl
runners.spotlight: Improved for the combination of a step up to 7f and fitting of a visor (retained) when only just failing to peg back a front-runner at Chelmsford last Thursday; good chance of going one better if in the same form.

runners.comment: Fourth of 12 on 6f course handicap and claims if pulling out a bit more for 7f.
runners.name: What A Tahoo
runners.owner: Richard Fahey Ebor Racing Club Ltd
runners.spotlight: Kept on for fourth of 12 on last month's 6f course handicap debut and it's possible 7f could see her pull out a bit more; enters calculations.

runners.comment: No form in four turf runs last year, including a 1m handicap; off six months
runners.name: Rupert Ritzik
runners.owner: A Dearing D Jenkins T Bradshaw N Watts
runners.spotlight: No form over a variety of trips on turf as a juvenile, including trailing throughout on 1m Redcar handicap debut in September; plenty of improvement will be needed switching to AW after six months off.
